name: io.github.joshuawowk/signal-mcp
title: Signal Messaging (via signal-cli)
description: Send Signal messages and read replies through your own signal-cli JSON-RPC daemon (unofficial).

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_SENDER
environmentVariables.description: E.164 number of the account registered in signal-cli (e.g. +15555550100)

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_DEFAULT_RECIPIENT
environmentVariables.description: E.164 number messaged by default; tools accept a per-call recipient override

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: signal-cli HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint as seen from the container. The server's built-in default is http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/rpc (use with --network host on Linux); this listing defaults to the Docker host alias.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_TCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: signal-cli daemon TCP host, used only for the receive-path health check

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_TCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: signal-cli daemon TCP port (daemon started with --tcp), used only for the receive-path health check

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_INBOX_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the replies inbox file inside the container (populated only by the subscriber process)

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_INBOX_RETENTION_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days of replies kept in the inbox file
